body.statement:
Fix \(\gamma\in(1/2,1)\).  Let \(N\to\infty\), let \(a_N,b_N>0\) satisfy \(a_Nb_N=o((\log N)^{-1/2})\), and consider the known-unit-variance Gaussian-treatment partially linear experiment with fixed uniformly bounded supplied treatment and outcome regression fits and an \(L^s\) nuisance uncertainty ball of radii \((a_N,b_N)\), where \(1\le s\le\infty\).  If \(\mathfrak P_N(a_N,b_N)\) denotes that experiment, then
\[
 \inf_{\widehat\vartheta}
 \sup_{R\in\mathfrak P_N(a_N,b_N)}
 Q_{R,1-\gamma}\!\left(
   |\widehat\vartheta-\vartheta(R)|
 \right)
 \ge c_\gamma\left\{
 N^{-1/2}+a_Nb_N
 \left(\frac{\log(1/a_N)}{\log N}\right)^3
 \right\},
\]
where the infimum is over all estimators based on the \(N\) observations and
\(Q_{R,u}(V)=\inf\{t:R(V\le t)\ge u\}\).  The bound is delivered by the moment-matched Gaussian fuzzy hypotheses in the cited source.

source.locator: Theorem 3.2, equation (6), with the Gaussian fuzzy construction in Section D, especially construction (44) and equations (55)--(58)
